## Sample cohort calculations

### A. Ordinary cohort, recomputed by hand

Cohort: `meta` installed 2025-04-28 (day 112); review as-of 2025-09-08 (day 245); D3 milestone complete: yes.

- installed players reported: 98; spend: 82.36
- CPI = spend / installs = 82.36 / 98 = 0.8404  (SQL: 0.8404)
- D1 retention = players with a day-1 row / ALL installed players = 37 / 98 = 0.3776  (SQL: 0.3776)
- D0-D3 gross IAP = 13.01; ad revenue = 8.5557; net = 13.01 x (1 - 0.3) + 8.5557 = 17.6627  (SQL: 17.6627)
- payer rate (D0-D3) = 3 / 98 = 0.0306  (SQL: 0.0306)
- ARPDAU (D0-D3) = net / active player-days = 17.6627 / 174 = 0.1015  (SQL: 0.1015)

### B. Delayed-reporting trap: cohort not yet complete

Cohort: `unity` installed 2025-10-26 (day 293); review as-of 2025-11-03 (day 301); D3 milestone complete: NO.

- installed players reported: 48; spend: 58.09
- D3 metrics are NULL in SQL by design (SQL: cpi=nan, d0_3_net_revenue=nan).
- the raw visible D0-D3 net revenue so far would be 5.1999 from 56 visible player-days: a partial number that must not be used.

## Generator QA: scenario calibration intents (thresholds committed before generation; checked against the dev seed)

This is generator QA, not model or agent evidence. The generator was calibrated after a first dev run in which 4 of 17 intents failed, and one intent's cohort window was amended (both disclosed in the Phase 1 commit and in `evals/scenarios/delayed_reporting.json`). `true_step20_marginal_roas_over_target` is an approximate calibration proxy (value per install assumed proportional to player quality), not exact simulation truth, and is never an experiment-scoring oracle.

| scenario | metric | value | must be | result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cpi_spike | cpi_spike_ratio_to_trailing_median | 2.068 | >= 1.6 | PASS |
| delayed_reporting | min_report_lag_days | 6.000 | >= 6 | PASS |
| delayed_reporting | other_channels_max_report_lag_days | 2.000 | <= 2 | PASS |
| delayed_reporting | naive_visible_d3_revenue_fraction | 0.064 | <= 0.6 | PASS |
| front_loaded | d3_net_revenue_per_install_rank | 1.000 | <= 2 | PASS |
| front_loaded | d30_to_d3_multiplier_over_peer_median | 0.587 | <= 0.65 | PASS |
| front_loaded | avg_d30_roas_over_target | 0.756 | <= 0.9 | PASS |
| regime_shift | iap_per_active_day_post_over_pre | 0.728 | <= 0.9 | PASS |
| regime_shift | ad_ecpm_post_over_pre | 1.103 | >= 1.05 | PASS |
| saturating_imperfect_curve | avg_d30_roas_over_target | 1.875 | >= 1.2 | PASS |
| saturating_imperfect_curve | true_step20_marginal_roas_over_target | 0.358 | <= 0.8 | PASS |
| steady_winner | avg_d30_roas_over_target | 1.833 | >= 1.4 | PASS |
| steady_winner | true_step20_marginal_roas_over_target | 1.383 | >= 1.2 | PASS |
| tiny_sample_whale | window_installs_per_day_max | 7.000 | <= 15 | PASS |
| tiny_sample_whale | whale_cohort_d3_net_over_normal_median | 40.359 | >= 5 | PASS |
| tracking_outage | outage_event_drop_fraction | 0.919 | >= 0.7 | PASS |
| tracking_outage | outage_install_change_abs | 0.111 | <= 0.25 | PASS |
